select p.perm_id AS permId, p.perm_code AS permCode, p.perm_name AS permName, p.perm_type AS permType, p.module_code AS moduleCode, p.menu_group AS menuGroup, p.action_code AS actionCode, p.url_path AS urlPath, p.status AS status, p.sort_no AS sortNo, p.remark AS remark, rp.role_id AS extFieldLong
from expdb.exp_permission p left join expdb.exp_role_permission_rel rp on p.perm_id = rp.perm_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} order by p.sort_no
